title: jmri-json-route-client-message
description: Schema data object in message from client to JMRI for type "route"

userName.description: If present, set the user name of the route

comment.description: If present, set the comment for the route; null clears it

state.description: If present, 2 (active) or 8 (toggle) sets the route; 0 and 4 do nothing
